problem_solution_fit.name: Problem–Solution Fit
problem_solution_fit.description: Clarity and severity of customer pain point, validated need, and directness of the proposed solution.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Urgent, well-defined problem affecting identifiable users; clear value proposition with 10x improvement over status quo.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Real problem exists but solution lacks sharp differentiation or targets a diffuse audience; value prop is incremental.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Vague problem, solution looking for a problem, or users already adequately served by free/existing alternatives.

market_size_timing.name: Market Size & Timing
market_size_timing.description: Total Addressable Market (TAM), serviceable market (SAM), obtainable market (SOM), market growth rate (CAGR), and timing tailwinds.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Large growing market (TAM > $10B or expanding > 15% CAGR); strong timing tailwinds (regulations, tech shifts, behavior changes).
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Moderate market ($1B-$10B) with modest growth (5-15% CAGR); neutral timing or standard market dynamics.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Niche or shrinking market (< $1B, < 5% CAGR); headwinds or saturated legacy space with high barriers.

competition_moat.name: Competition & Moat
competition_moat.description: Competitive landscape density, incumbent positioning, and presence of defensible moats (network effects, switching costs, tech IP).

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Clear uncrowded positioning gap or unique defensible moat; well-understood competitor weaknesses.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Moderate competition; differentiation exists but can be copied; limited structural moats in early stages.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Red ocean dominated by well-funded incumbents with negligible switching costs; zero tangible moats.

customer_demand.name: Customer Demand
customer_demand.description: Target persona clarity, evidence of urgency, validated willingness to pay, and customer acquisition pull.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Concrete personas with demonstrated urgency and proven willingness to pay; clear pull.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: General buyer profile; theoretical interest exists but commercial commitment is unverified.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Broad untargeted demographic; low willingness to pay or high reluctance to switch from current habits.

business_model.name: Business Model
business_model.description: Monetization strategy clarity, pricing alignment with customer value, recurring revenue potential, and scalability.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: High-margin recurring or transactional model with high pricing power and clear unit revenue expansion.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Viable monetization model, but margin pressure or single-stream revenue vulnerability exists.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Unclear monetization ('will monetize later via ads') or negative unit economics at baseline.

unit_economics.name: Unit Economics
unit_economics.description: LTV:CAC ratio (healthy >= 3x), gross margin % (SaaS >= 70%), payback period (< 12 months), and churn stability.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: LTV:CAC >= 3.5x, gross margin > 65%, payback <= 12 months, low churn (< 3%/mo).
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: LTV:CAC between 2.0x-3.0x, margins 40-60%, or payback 12-18 months.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: LTV:CAC < 1.5x (losing money per customer acquired), gross margins < 30%, payback > 24 months, or high churn.

team_execution.name: Team & Execution
team_execution.description: Founder-market fit, technical competence, relevant domain experience, completeness of early core team.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Proven domain expertise, balanced technical and business capabilities, prior startup or leadership track record.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Capable team with relevant skills, but missing key functional domain or technical leadership.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Solo non-technical founder with no domain background and no technical execution partner.

traction_growth.name: Traction & Growth
traction_growth.description: User growth velocity, paying customer velocity, monthly growth rate (MoM), and cohort retention.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Strong organic/paid MoM growth (> 15%), high retention, consistent customer acquisition.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Steady growth (5-12% MoM) with moderate customer acquisition velocity and average churn.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Flat or declining growth (< 3% MoM), customer churn exceeding acquisition rate, high dormancy.

financial_health.name: Financial Health
financial_health.description: Runway length (> 12-18 months healthy), monthly burn rate vs revenue, and capital efficiency.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Runway >= 15 months, disciplined burn rate, clear path to cash-flow breakeven or next funding milestone.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Runway 6-12 months, manageable burn, but requires imminent fundraising within 2 quarters.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: Runway < 5 months with unsustainable burn rate and no committed bridge round.

legal_compliance.name: Legal & Compliance Risk
legal_compliance.description: Regulatory exposure, IP protection, licensing mandates, data privacy (DPDP/GDPR), and regulatory compliance posture.

criteria.high: Score 7-10: Low regulatory friction or fully compliant with relevant licenses, data privacy standards, and IP secured.
criteria.medium: Score 4-6.9: Moderate regulatory requirements (standard consent frameworks, basic licensing needed) with manageable compliance steps.
criteria.low: Score 0-3.9: High regulatory risk (unlicensed financial activity, health non-compliance, active IP infringement, DPDP violations).
